item.title: PM Denies Abaco Link, Eleuthera Bridge, BPL Debt Soars
item.ns0:title: PM Denies Abaco Link, Eleuthera Bridge, BPL Debt Soars
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, Prime Minister Philip Davis strongly rejects allegations of political or personal ties to a slain Abaco man following a controversial photograph circulating on social media. Just days into the new school year, the Bahamas Union of Teachers overwhelmingly votes to take industrial action, putting the nation on alert. We track the money to reveal the staggering multi-million-dollar financial burden the ongoing power crisis is placing on taxpayers, while shanty town residents on the Family Islands are put on notice that demolitions will resume within weeks. Plus, we bring you long-awaited construction updates on crucial bridges in Eleuthera and Andros, and celebrate local sports stars making major moves on the international stage.
